oracle.differential_check: Zero canonical naming build where a completed answer exists

retained_representation_lie_preflight.request_construction: Use the frozen Phase 0.5 32-target generator per representation, deduplicate exact targets, and retain the Phase 0.6 binding and replay orders.
retained_representation_lie_preflight.execution: Two complete passes through the same pinned persistent LiE 2.2.2 harness.
retained_representation_lie_preflight.requirement: Every representation must pass resource and replay gates before corpus generation; comparison with every available completed Zero answer is required.

decision_surface.target_rule: exact oracle multiplicity in 0-31; values above 31 remain excluded from the decision gate

exceptional_sampling.threshold_derivation: For a changed type, multiply the original Revision 3 threshold by source_count/retained_count and round up. This conservatively assigns zero accuracy to the excluded tail under a representation-uniform reference distribution.
